name: Scoped To Compliance Exception Target
description: An exception instance is limited to a place: a scope anchor, such as a package (ecosystem, name, version), an image or an SBOM document. Wildcard target because what a producer's world offers as an anchor is not compliance_core's to name. The anchors of one instance are ANDed and the producer declares how many it meant in anchor_count; an instance with no live anchor covers nothing. That an anchor actually reaches a covered finding is the checker's binding, which compliance_core trusts and does not verify.
